scope: Independent re-review of frozen-tool identity repair plus rerun of CP08 benchmark controls. Prior source review of full-build/runtime boundaries and failure scoring remains applicable to unchanged code.

checks.name: original scoring and repaired tool identity controls
independently reconstructed actual inventory/load drift cases
coverage: ld.lld alias retarget to identical bytes with old target unchanged
new paired ld.lld appearing after plan freeze
checks.fixture_level: Synthetic executable files; actual inventory and load; only rustc sysroot subprocess probe mocked. Unchanged load succeeds before every mutation.

reasoning: Compiler/library/linker identities preserve absolute invocation path, resolved target path, direct symlink text and target bytes/stat. Clang and LLD multicall names are no longer collapsed to their target basenames.
Explicit ZIL_LINUX_LINKER paths and PATH names are enumerated automatically; system retains its explicit no-override meaning.
Load repeats candidate selection against the frozen PATH and override, detecting appearance of higher-priority PATH tools or a paired sibling in addition to mutations of existing tools.
Original two rejection gaps are closed; scoring/warmup/absolute-weight aggregation code is unchanged by this repair.
limitations: No performance run or full-workspace/native platform acceptance is claimed.
A new frozen plan is required; historical plans and smoke evidence are not rewritten.
This is benchmark-tool correctness review, not a ZIL-over-Rust performance verdict.
